author: TEDx Talks
description:
Right now, a conversation is running inside your cells that began 1.5 billion years ago, and it may decide how you age. Mitochondria, the bacteria-turned-power-plants of our cells, constantly exchange signals with their neighbors through energy, reactive oxygen species, and calcium, but with age this exchange doesn’t fade, it overheats. Molecular biologist Corina Madreiter-Sokolowski shows what goes wrong in this conversation and why learning to keep it fine-tuned might be the key to healthy aging. Corina Madreiter-Sokolowski is a molecular biologist and Professor at the Gottfried Schatz Research Center, Medical University of Graz, where she serves as Deputy Head of the Division of Molecular Biology and Biochemistry. Her research explores how mitochondria communicate with the rest of the cell — and how that communication changes as we age.
After her Ph.D., she conducted research at various institutions including ETH Zurich and Les Laboratoires Servier (Paris), before starting her own
title: Mitochondria: How communication shapes our future | Corina Madreiter-Sokolowski | TEDxMedUniGraz

author: TEDx Talks
description:
For too long, society has viewed disability through the narrow lens of sympathy, reducing extraordinary human potential to a narrative of charity. In From Helped to Helpers: Rewriting the Story of Disability, Moses Chowdari of EnAble India challenges this outdated perspective through three powerful real-life stories of individuals with disabilities who did more than overcome barriers they went on to lead, build, and empower others. It is a compelling call to replace pity with possibility and rethink how we recognize capability, dignity, and the invaluable contributions of people with disabilities.

With sincere gratitude to our Principal, University Management, Faculty Coordinators, Core Organizing Team, Student Volunteers, and Sponsors, we extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who supported us in bringing this event to life. Your guidance, dedication, and unwavering encouragement made this journey possible.

TEDxKLH University Bowrampet Licensee & Organizer - Bobba Thambi Aashish
title: From Helped to Helpers: Rewriting Ability | Moses Chowdari Gorrepati | TEDxKLH University Bowrampet

description: In The Courage to Be a Beginner Again, Tom Solo explores how resilience is not just about overcoming adversity, but about embracing uncertainty and finding the courage to reinvent ourselves. Drawing on his personal journey from craftsman to photographer, voice actor, and entrepreneur, he shares how curiosity, creativity, concentration, and courage can turn new beginnings into opportunities for growth. Tom Solo is a German artist, creative entrepreneur, and investor whose unconventional career has taken him from award-winning craftsmanship to international photography and collaborations with some of the world's leading brands and film studios as a voice actor. Driven by curiosity and creativity, he connects the worlds of art, business, and innovation, turning bold ideas into meaningful opportunities. author: TEDx Talks
description:
Skye Berger takes the "sky is falling" moments of life to a level of engagement and understanding that invites you to fold strife into your success equation. She teaches that everything happening in your life happens to make you whole.
 Playwright, astrologer, Reiki master, sound healer whose work lives in intersection of the cosmos, the body, and community transformation. A lifelong student of cycles and an Intimacy Professional, she holds space for others to come home to themselves weaving systems thinking and soul work into one human practice. Through The Skye Webb Walker Simulation, she creates multidisciplinary works that ask souls to seek their center. This Story Telling Slam is a culmination of curating Afrofuturist healing praxis, her body of work spans original theater, cooperative game design, and civic arts organizing. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: How to Alchemize Stigma within a Falling Sky  | Skye Berger | TEDxGary

Kristin Zamora knows what it means to paint on purpose and for a purpose. Her idea grew into a practice where she uses paint to reveal past trauma and hurt. Her courage empowers others to release, reveal, and heal together through the shared act of creating.
 Kristen Zamora is an artist, speaker, and creator of Healing Through Body Art, an immersive storytelling project that uses symbolic body painting to help people transform deeply personal experiences into visible works of art. For more than a decade, Kristen has explored the intersection of creativity, vulnerability, and human connection. Through her work, participants collaborate to express experiences that often feel impossible to describe with words alone.

title: Visible Stories Can Create Space For Other Voices | Kristen Zamora | TEDxGary

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Having big dreams without a roadmap can be terrifying, especially when your earliest ideas fail and the very team you trusted walks away in pursuit of safer opportunities. In When Everyone Walks Away, Build Anyway, Madhulash of Edodwaja shares the raw, unfiltered story of battling crippling self-doubt and navigating complete isolation long before government support and media recognition came his way. What emerged from that struggle was more than just a venture; it was a mission to bring technology into rural classrooms. His journey is a powerful reminder that true metamorphosis begins when you find the courage to keep going, even when nobody is left standing beside you.

Who is responsible when the next generation develops the wrong habits, attitudes and behaviours? Is it the children, the parents or society?

In this thought-provoking talk, a life coach, teacher, author and mentor introduces her campaign, **"Parenting the Parent,"** and challenges us to rethink the way we understand parenting and generational responsibility.

Through four real-life situations, she highlights how children's behaviour, values and attitudes are often shaped by what they observe at home. From disrespectful behaviour and a lack of professional responsibility to unhealthy habits and the consequences of irresponsible parenting, she explores the connection between parental actions and children's development.

The talk highlights an important contradiction: parents often criticize the younger generation for behaviours that they may have unknowingly taught through their own actions.

description:
What happens when you spend most of your life fulfilling everyone else's expectations and slowly lose sight of who you really are?

In this inspiring talk, **Binita Srivastava** shares her remarkable journey of rediscovering her identity at the age of 47.

After spending years as a wife, mother and daughter-in-law, her life took an unexpected turn in 2017 when her family faced a major financial setback and had to restart their lives in India with just ₹50,000.

Faced with difficult circumstances, she made a choice to rebuild not only her family's future but also her own identity. In 2019, she began her journey through beauty pageants, eventually becoming an author, entrepreneur, speaker, mentor and transformational leader.

Through her personal experiences, she introduces a framework for personal transformation: **Ignite your Identity, Nurture your Learning, Inspire others, Transform yourself, and Achieve and Amplify your growth.**

description: What if the fear of looking foolish is what keeps us from discovering what we're capable of? Artist and filmmaker Pranav Sasidharan reflects on his journey of embracing the freedom to explore, experiment, make mistakes, and begin again. His talk challenges the way we define success and failure, reminding us that creativity thrives when we give ourselves permission to keep becoming. With over a decade of experience across visual and movement arts, Pranav Sasidharan has directed, written, and produced some of the most prominent music videos, advertisements, and live concerts. His directorial Ballaatha Jaathi was named among Rolling Stone India’s Top 10 Music Videos of 2024. His creative journey has taken him from the digital spaces of Kerala to global platforms like the Cannes Film Festival. description:
What if medicine has been studying only half the picture? For decades, the male body has served as the default in medical research, shaping everything from the treatments we receive to the AI helping diagnose us. This talk uncovers the hidden biases behind modern medicine and challenges us to rethink what “normal” means—and who gets left out. Pamela Waked is a biomedical scientist with a background in biochemistry and biomedical sciences and a strong interest in the intersection of science, health, technology, and society. Her research experience spans molecular and translational medicine, with a particular interest in understanding how biological differences shape health and disease.

Beyond research, Pamela is passionate about science communication, global health advocacy, and strengthening the dialogue between science, policy, and society. title: The Default Human: Who is medicine designed for? | Pamela Waked | TEDxMedUniGraz

In healthcare, the right treatment matters, but so does the conversation that leads to it. 
Drawing on two experiences from the intensive care unit, Dr. Wirya explores how 
communication, teamwork, and the ability to speak up can influence patient safety. He 
challenges the assumption that clinical knowledge alone is enough, highlighting the need 
for structured communication, shared decision-making, and collaborative training across 
healthcare professions. His central message is that communication is more than a soft 
skill; it is an essential part of patient care.
 Wirya Mukryani is a healthcare professional, healthcare trainer, and public speaker from Kirkuk, Iraq. He has extensive clinical experience, particularly in Intensive Care Units (ICU) and Coronary Care Units (CCU).

Mariza Fotiou’s talk explores the relationship between risk, personal growth, and social impact. Drawing on her experiences in the corporate world and her work creating opportunities for vulnerable communities, she highlights the power of resilience, adaptability, and human solidarity.

"Home isn't just a place you find. It's a sense of belonging you create."

What does it take to turn a place into somewhere you truly feel at home?

Drawing on a personal journey of moving from Germany to Switzerland, this talk explores how belonging doesn't simply happen to us — it's something we can actively create.

But the experience goes beyond settling into a new country. It touches on a universal human need: the desire to feel accepted, connected, and truly part of something.

Through four personal lessons, the talk explores the importance of commitment, openness, staying true to your identity, and learning to adapt without losing yourself.

The message is simple yet powerful: Feeling at home isn't just about where you live. It's about how you build belonging. Originally from southern Germany, Stefanie Schwärzli has called Switzerland home for the past five years, following several moves throughout her life. description: After years of working his way up from the stores room, David landed the dream job of every mechanic: working at Formula 1. But what do you do when your dream job turns out to be a nightmare? In his talk, David traces a life of changing course, from motocross to music to poetry, and makes the case for having the confidence to stop when something doesn’t suit you. David McKirdy is a celebrated Hong Kong poet, motor mechanic, and KGV alumnus whose life bridges the gap between industrial craftsmanship and literary art. Known as a polymath of the local creative scene, he spent decades restoring vintage cars and motorcycles for high-profile fleets while simultaneously becoming a pillar of the city’s poetry community. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

What does it really mean to be perfect? How often do we put other people’s needs before our own just to be accepted? And what happens when the roles we have learned to fulfil distance us from our true selves?
In her talk, Artemis Monachogiou explores the pressure to be perfect, social stereotypes, and the expectations that often distance us from our authentic selves. Through personal experiences and examples of social taboos, she highlights the importance of self-acceptance, personal freedom, and authenticity.

Πώς παίρνουμε αποφάσεις όταν το άγχος, ο φόβος ή η αμφιβολία μάς κρατούν ανάμεσα σε δύο επιλογές; Πρέπει άραγε να βρούμε τη «σωστή» απόφαση ή εκείνη που, για τη συγκεκριμένη στιγμή, είναι η πιο συνετή;

Η Ελεάννα Καλούδη μιλά στη σκηνή του TEDxIonianUniversity για τη σημασία της ηρεμίας πριν από μια δύσκολη επιλογή, για τη δέσμευση στην απόφαση που τελικά παίρνουμε και για τον ρόλο των ανθρώπων που μας στηρίζουν χωρίς να μας κρίνουν. Μια ομιλία για τις σκέψεις και τα συναισθήματα που μας οδηγούν στα άκρα, αλλά και για το πώς μπορούμε να προχωράμε με περισσότερη εμπιστοσύνη στον εαυτό μας. Η Ελεάννα Καλούδη είναι Συστημική Οικογενειακή Θεραπεύτρια, μέλος της Ευρωπαϊκής Εταιρείας Θεραπείας της Οικογένειας και της Ελληνικής Εταιρείας Συμβουλευτικής. Η εργασία και τα ενδιαφέροντά της επικεντρώνονται στη δυναμική των διαπροσωπικών σχέσεων και τη σημασία τους στην ψυχική υγειά του ατόμου. Η ακαδημαϊκή της σχέση με την Ψυχολογία ξεκίνησε στο Τμήμα Φιλοσοφίας, Παιδαγωγικής και Ψυχολογίας του
title: Το Παζλ της Απόφασης | Ελεάννα Καλούδη | TEDxIonianUniversity

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Should we fear Artificial Intelligence or learn to use it responsibly? Can technology strengthen critical thinking, or do we risk becoming dependent on it? And ultimately, how can we prepare students for a constantly changing world?
Marios Magioladitis’s talk explores the relationship between technological progress and technophobia, focusing on the role of Artificial Intelligence in education. Through historical examples and contemporary reflections, he highlights the importance of critical thinking, pedagogical responsibility, and meaningful learning.

Εργάστηκε για 7 χρόνια ως επιστημονικός συνεργάτης στα Πανεπιστήμια του Duisburg-Essen και του Oldenburg στη Γερμανία. title: Μεταίχμιο τεχνολογίας και τεχνοφοβίας στην εκπαίδευση  | Μάριος Μαγιολαδίτης | TEDxIonianUniversity
